title: Framer hero
description: A left-aligned black hero: a tight two-line geometric title, two lines of grey copy, a white and a dark-grey small button with an aside link on the far right, then a wide 16:9 video frame with a hairline and soft corners (full-bleed between hairlines on phones).
notes: the video is a media slot (`media`); empty, it shows a panel placeholder of the same frame
sits right below framer-header (which brings its own spacer)
name: framer-hero

props.description: two lines of grey copy under the title
